entries.title: Hidden Agenda

emulation.notes: Requires PS4 and the PlayLink mobile app for the intended control scheme.

primary.why: Hidden Agenda is a PS4-exclusive PlayLink crime thriller with smartphone/tablet voting controls, so PS4 is the only sourced route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PlayStation 4 with the PlayLink mobile app on Android or iOS devices for the intended solo or group-control experience.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original PS4 release; no remake/remaster distinction applies.
